title: SandboxOptions
description: Configuration options for initializing a Sandbox instance

backend.description: Execution backend identifier (e.g. native, docker, firecracker, wasi)

cpu.description: Number of CPU cores allocated (quota semantics). Enforced by containerized backends; experimental for the native backend.

cpuQuota.description: CPU core allocation quota (e.g. 0.5). Experimental: native backend does not yet enforce hard quota; requires cgroups v2 / Job Objects.

cpuTimeLimit.description: CPU time budget in milliseconds (e.g. 2000). Supported boundary: enforced across the full process group by the native backend. Distinct from timeout (wall-clock).

workDir.description: Working directory inside the sandbox environment

image.description: Container image identifier (only used by docker or microvm backends)
